text: The gate (cli-generator v1.25.8) fails in pytest before DATAIO-035's work. 1) The gate runs pytest with CI_ENV = GITHUB_ACTIONS=true, FORCE_COLOR=1, PY_COLORS=1 (rb_release/gate.py run_command, standard.CI_ENV). 29 tests of human CLI output and help snapshots then see ANSI codes and fail (test_auth, test_backup, test_bases_core, test_cli, test_cli_frame, test_cli_target_columns, test_help snapshots, test_sqlite). The same suite without these variables passes. 2) tests/test_scripts.py::test_antagor_project_config is stale against .agents/antagor/antagor.toml: GATE pins v1.25.0 (toml has v1.25.8, commit 5a11237), and [publish] gained gate and gate_status_url (commit 1e3035e). Both need a task of their own: the CLI output has to stay plain under FORCE_COLOR, or the tests have to strip colour.
note: Fixed outside the task: DATAIO-031 (tests plain under GITHUB_ACTIONS/FORCE_COLOR) and DATAIO-032/033 (the [publish] table, gate v1.25.8) are in main since v0.1.29, whose CI ran gate v1.25.8 green; the branch was cut before them.
